provenance.coverage: 17 required invariants (coverage, decomposition, waves, overlaps, tightness, touch accuracy, named paths, consumption edges, AC mapping/ownership) + 8 constraints (AC vocab, test-ladder classification, environment rules, routing vocab/pure-logic routing, size, task tests, MCP tool scope); deterministic only.
provenance.derivation: Inputs are exact base-commit bytes of specs/projects/kerrigan-dashboard/{plan,spec}.md, the delegation-rubric/test-ladder/test-environment skills, tools/conflict_predictor.py and the full repository file list. planning/deliverables.md is a derived index giving each plan.md M2-M8 deliverable bullet a stable ID, the paths plan.md names, and the consumption edges plan.md states (each edge holds transitively in the merged tasks.md). Reference PLAN.json transcribes the merged tasks.md (23 tasks M2.1-M8.3: Touch, Dependencies, Tests) and acceptance-tests.md (AC->task, level) into JSON; two soft/absent scaffold deps (M3.1, M4.1 on M2.1) are made explicit, waves are the ASAP waves of the declared deps+touch overlaps (8), routing ids are added from the rubric, AC-019 (M1-only) is dropped and AC-015 keeps one level. Checks are invariants (coverage, file-accurate touch, recomputed overlaps/tight waves, transitive consumption edges, closed vocabularies, sizes), not the oracle's particular decomposition.
provenance.historical_exposure: Public historical planning PR; exposure/recognition risk.
provenance.limitations: No model trial, representative-day coverage, native isolation, or contamination-free claim.
